lines.t: No intro, no break, when it drops, that’s war,
Bass hit, block shake, demons hit the floor.
Fake “jesus” on the wall, dirty cash in the plate,
New York with the Trumpet, bringin’ judgment to your gate.
No peace, no love, we ain’t cool, we ain’t friends,
Every bar like a shot, this is how it all ends.
Pick a side, no split, better choose who you wit’,
YahuShua or the world, you can’t ride in the middle of this.
[/hook]
I’m on the corner with the text, Volumes in the bag,
Scripture in my right hand, left hand on the flag.
I ain’t talkin’ ‘bout a Glock when I say I let it spark,
When I up it, it’s the Word, put the beam in the dark.
Seven hills on the target, Rome lookin’ like a don,
Purple robe, gold trim, but the soul long gone.
Cup full of blood, saints’ blood in the mix,
Call her “mother of the church,” I just see a dirty trick.
Pope in the palace, plays lookin’ like a scheme,
Politicians on the line, whole system on the team.
Preachin’ dead “jesus,” soft, no fire,
Whole block trained up on a Sunday liar.
Protestant daughters, same bed, same sin,
Same Christmas tree, same Easter grin.
Halloween demons in the kids’ disguise,
Parents laugh it off with the death in their eyes.
You screamin’ “Under grace” while you back in the trap,
Still chasin’ clout, still lovin’ that cap.
One Law broke, that’s the whole case blown,
You can’t beat Truth when the facts all shown.
[/verse]
No intro, no break, when it drops, that’s war,
Bass hit, block shake, demons hit the floor.
Fake “jesus” on the wall, dirty cash in the plate,
New York with the Trumpet, bringin’ judgment to your gate.
No peace, no love, we ain’t cool, we ain’t friends,
Every bar like a shot, this is how it all ends.
Pick a side, no split, better choose who you wit’,
YahuShua or the world, you can’t ride in the middle of this.
[/hook]
Christmas in the projects, lights on, hearts froze,
Santa on the door, lust under those clothes.
Tree from Babylon, wrapped tight, lookin’ clean,
You say “It’s for the kids,” but the root obscene.
Easter Sunday fit cost more than the rent,
Egg hunts, brunch flex, whole check spent.
Cross on the chain, but the life still foul,
Ain’t no fear of Elohim when you dappin’ the crowd.
Halloween on the block, lil’ ones masked up,
Candy in the bag, spirits in the cup.
You open up the crib, let the same ones in,
Then question why your house feel heavy with sin.
Clinics in the hood, babies in the trash,
Laws on the books so the rich keep cash.
Blood talk from the ground, that file ain’t lost,
Heaven got the footage of the lives you tossed.
You vote for the slaughter, then you post “God bless,”
Sunday selfie with the pastor, drippin’ in finesse.
Wrath in the chamber like a round in the nine,
When it click in the spirit, whole world out of time.
[/verse]
No intro, no break, when it drops, that’s war,
Bass hit, block shake, demons hit the floor.
Fake “jesus” on the wall, dirty cash in the plate,
New York with the Trumpet, bringin’ judgment to your gate.
No peace, no love, we ain’t cool, we ain’t friends,
Every bar like a shot, this is how it all ends.
Pick a side, no split, better choose who you wit’,
YahuShua or the world, you can’t ride in the middle of this.
[/hook]
They preach another “jesus,” smile, no crown,
He don’t talk ‘bout sin, never says “Stand down.”
Mascot, puppet, that ain’t no King,
That’s a logo on a flyer that they push for the green.
YahuShua real raw, fire in His stare,
Lion of Yehudah, you can feel Him in the air.
Rod in His hand, Law carved in His core,
He ain’t co‑signin’ when you spit on His Torah.
He call you to die, not flex with the filth,
Crucify the flesh, let it bleed, no guilt.
Whole life on the line, whole set gon’ watch,
When you really walk with Him, old gang get chopped.
Come out from the harlot, Rome and her crew,
Come out from the megachurch circus you knew.
This world like a lick with the cops down the block,
You can chase that high, but the case still locked.
I ain’t scared of your chain, I don’t care ‘bout your name,
I just fear Elohim, and I know His flame.
When He slide on the earth like a squad in the van,
Ain’t nobody thug then when He stretch out His hand.
[/verse]
North face zipped, word tucked in the coat,
Pull up to the steeple like, “Everybody note.”
I ain’t talkin’ ‘bout smoke when I say, “Let it rain,”
I’m talkin’ ‘bout the Truth that expose your game.
Project baby, washed but the grit still real,
I just switched sides, now the Kingdom is the deal.
False ones fold when the Sword come through,
If you love the dark, this whole track dissin’ you.
If you broken, if you stained, He can clean that mark,
If you love your sin, you gon’ die in that dark.
Pick a side, no fence, no halfway step,
It’s YahuShua or death when you take that breath.
[/bridge]
No intro, no break, when it drops, that’s war,
Bass hit, block shake, demons hit the floor.
Fake “jesus” on the wall, dirty cash in the plate,
New York with the Trumpe
